current_concerns.primary_problems: Well, the back pain is the big one, it’s been hanging around since that injury at work back in 2019 and it never really let up. And then lately I’ve just been feeling low, not sleeping properly, not interested in things much—I stopped going to church and the social groups, which isn’t like me. I’m trying to get the pain better controlled, really, and get myself back to my choir.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly I want help managing the pain better… and to get back to my choir, if I can.
